message.content:
**Yes – you can file a noise complaint in Atlanta.**  
Atlanta’s noise‑control system is handled through the **City of Atlanta Police Department** (and the city’s own Noise Control Division). Here’s how you can do it:

| Step | What to Do | Where to Go / Who to Call |
|------|------------|---------------------------|
| 1 | **Check the city’s noise ordinance** (to confirm the violation and the time window). | <https://www.atlantaga.gov/311> (search “Noise Ordinance”) |
| 2 | **File an online complaint** (if you prefer digital). | <https://www.atlantaga.gov/311> → “Report a Problem” → select “Noise” |
| 3 | **Call 311** (or 404‑656‑4000 if you’re outside Atlanta). | 311 (within Atlanta) or 404‑656‑4000 (outside) |
| 4 | **Visit the Police Department’s Noise Control Office** (for in‑person filing or follow‑up). | 300‑400‑NOISE (300‑400‑6633) – 1st Floor, City Hall, 55 Marietta Street NE, Atlanta, GA 30303 |
| 5 | **Follow up** – the police will investigate and may issue a citation if the noise violates the ordinance. | Contact the officer assigned to your case or check the status online. |

### Quick Tips

- **Time limits:** Noise complaints are typically limited to certain hours (e.g., 10 p.m.–7 a.m.). Check the ordinance for exact times.
- **Evidence:** If possible, record the noise or note the time and location; this helps the investigators.
- **Multiple complaints:** If the same source repeatedly violates the ordinance, the police can issue a citation or take further action.

### Useful Links

- **City of Atlanta 311 Portal:** <https://www.atlantaga.gov/311>
- **Noise Ordinance PDF:** <https://www.atlantaga.gov/sites/default/files/2024-02/Noise%20Ordinance.pdf>
- **Police Department Contact Page:** <https://www.atlantaga.gov/department/police>

If you’re outside Atlanta, you can still call 311 from any phone, and they’ll route you to the correct local office. Good luck—your city takes noise complaints seriously!
